items.title: AISI sets out its approach to technical best practice for frontier AI development
items.summary_en: An AISI blog post dated 12 Oct 2026, according to a search snippet, says AISI wants to contribute its expertise to an industry-wide effort on technical standards and best practice, not to impose mandatory requirements. It reportedly draws on about three years of testing and argues capability progress has outpaced some existing risk-management practices.
